deploy-bot: Rolling out service-api v3.2.1 to prod (change window 22:00-22:30 UTC). Backout playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-service-v3.2.1 :rocket:
sam: oncall ack. I'll be primary rollback owner for first 15m. Ping me on any canary hold.
nina: Release lead here. Watch for canary rule: abort if 5xx > 0.8% for 3m OR error spike > 2x baseline for two consecutive checks.
ops_jo: Heads-up: runbook step 5 toggles DB feature flag. IMPORTANT: do not invalidate caches until DB flag verified. I added a note in the runbook (section "db-safety").
sre-oncall: Preflight checks done: healthchecks green, infra quotas ok. Monitoring alert policy active: channels -> #alerts and pager.
kate: Communication plan: if rollback, post short summary to #deploy-notify and draft CS blurb. Docs: hold merge for changelog until stable.
docs_lucas: noted. I'll queue a revert PR template so we can revert changelog fast if needed.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: stage1 complete (15% traffic). Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/service-api/v3.2.1/canary
sam: stage1 metrics look OK. No 5xx, p95 latency +8ms. Continuing to 50%.
ops_jo: Reminder of rollback command (ops console): `./deployctl rollback --service service-api --env prod --to-version v3.2.0 --reason "canary"` — runbook also lists DB-readonly sequence.
nina: If we hit a transient latency blip under 10m with no error rate increase -> consider pinning traffic and monitoring. If sustained or errors -> full rollback.
sre-oncall: I'll run the automated canary-check script to post holds to this thread if thresholds breach.
sam: If rollback executed, follow runbook steps: 1) set DB feature flag off, 2) switch traffic, 3) verify read/write probes, 4) then perform cache invalidate only after DB consistency confirmed.
kate: CS/Support: prepare customer-facing line: "We experienced a brief regression during a routine rollout and reverted to the prior version; services are stable."
docs_lucas: I've stashed the changelog PR; will revert it if rollback happens.
deploy-bot: Canary stage2 starting (50% traffic). Will report back in 5m or on any trigger. :eyes:
sam: thanks all. I'll circle back at 50% or earlier if any alert.
